name: Gagarin EN
description: A charismatic male voice in his 30s with a Russian accent speaking English. Confident, warm, and energetic ace fighter pilot. Slightly rugged, friendly bravado.
sample: Commander. So I am the first comrade in a hundred years — what an honor. Small craft are my specialty; I'll take you anywhere. Just say the word and I'll fly us through anything.
